english: Because the form of the Mantra is always found to be definitely ascertained directly from the Vedic text itself, independently of all use or purpose,etc. and the employment or the Purpose of the Mantra is always accepted in accordance with its singleness or multiplicity as cognised at the time that the text of the Mantra is ascertained.
